description: Searches academic databases (arXiv, Crossref, PMC, Semantic Scholar, Open Library, Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy) for papers matching a research query, downloads PDFs, and converts them to markdown. Use when grounding fictional science in real research, finding citations for existing content, or when user says "find papers", "search for research", "download papers", "what does real science say about", "ground this in research", "find citations", or "look up [scientific concept]". Does NOT map research onto canon formalism — use /integrating-research for that.
